coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: As per 青# (clean/pure) + 水 water → *pure* water → *clear*; *clean*; *purify*. *Cool* is a borrowed meaning. The reading シン refers to the Manchu Dynasty (1644-1911). Note the variant form 淸.
朖也。澂水之皃。从水青聲。
歩 here an abbreviated form# of 陟 climb + 水 water → *cross (over)* water in climbing → *be involved with/in* (← be concerned with affairs on both sides of a river).
As per 奐# (draw out of/away from) + 水 water → *great flow of water* (compare 灌) drawing away from a melting icepack.
流𢿱也。从水奐聲。
As per 者# (pile) + 水 water → waves/ripples figuratively piling atop each other in lapping at a shore → *strand*; *beach*. Compare 汀.
水。在常山中丘逢山，東入湡。从水者聲。《爾雅》曰：“小洲曰渚。”
As per 咸# (shut) + 水 water → (partially) shut off the flow of water → *reduce*; *decrease*; *diminish*; *dwindle*; *subtract* → *be hungry*.
損也。从水咸聲。
湯也。从水耎聲。
兪# remove + 水 water → *change* the water/liquid in a container → *be transformed*.
變汙也。从水俞聲。一曰渝水，在遼西臨俞，東出塞。
As per 亭# (stand/stand straight) + 水 water → standing/*stagnant water* → *stop*; *stay*.
榘 combines 矩 carpenter's square + 木 tree/wood → a wooden carpenter's square. 渠 is an abbreviated form# of 榘 + 水 water → *ditch/channel/canal* shaped like a carpenter's square.
水所居。从水，榘省聲。
As per 度# (pile in increments) + 水 water → *ferry* piles of objects across a river in increments → *cross* (a river) → *hand over* (← pass from one hand to another).
濟也。从水度聲。
As per 査# (pile) + 水 water → pile of *dregs*/*lees* at the bottom of a container. Compare 滓 and 糟. Depending on the font, the right-hand element may appear as 木 atop 旦.
As per 勃# (spring up) + 水 water → tumultuous *swell* of water.
屋# cover + 水 water → be covered with water → *well-moistened* → *blessings*; *luster*. Also, *great attentiveness* (← careful irrigation).
霑也。从水屋聲。
咼# (variant of 冎 round or rounded cavity) + 水 water → water swirling in a cavity → *whirlpool*; *eddy*.
没也。从水畏聲。

𥁕# is a depiction of a curved lid fitting its container in holding in the contents. 温 adds 水 water → hold in moisture and keep an object *warm/hot*. 温transforms the top element of 𥁕 into 日, but 𥁕 is the style found in derivative characters such as 慍, 褞, 縕, 醞 etc.
枼 as described in 葉 + 水 water. 渫 was originally a variant of 泄 (leak; flow), but acquired the meanings *dredge* and *clean out* (← create a successive flow in dredging/cleaning out). Compare 浚.
除去也。从水枼聲。
As per 則# (beside) + 水 water → place oneself beside a body of water to *measure* its depth → *predict*; *estimate*.
深所至也。从水則聲。
水。出隴西首陽渭首亭南谷，東入河。从水胃聲。杜林說。《夏書》以爲出鳥鼠山。雝州浸也。
巷# (densely populated) + 水 water → *port* settlement → *harbor*.
水派也。从水䢽聲。
雲雨皃。从水弇聲。
飲也。从水弭聲。
As per 曷# (cut off) + 水 water → *cut off a supply of water* → *parched*; *thirst*.
盡也。从水曷聲。

As per 斿# (float) + 水 water → *float*; *drift*; *swim*. *Roam* and *wander* are borrowed meanings via 遊 → *enjoy* (← enjoy a rambling life). 游 was devised to replace 斿 after 斿 acquired its borrowed meanings.
旌旗之流也。从㫃汓聲。
As per 眇# (obscure) + 水 water → obscure edges of a wide expanse of water → *dim*; *boundless*.
少減也。一曰水門。又，水出丘前謂之渻丘。从水省聲。
As per 軍# (circularity) + 水 water → mix liquid with a circular motion, causing it to become *turbid* → *as a whole* (← mix thoroughly).
混流聲也。从水軍聲。一曰洿下皃。
沛之也。从水柰聲。
湀辟，深水處也。从水癸聲。
湁湒，𩰾也。从水拾聲。
As per 拜# (split away/apart) + 水 water → (the sound of) waves that crash on rocks and split apart → *the sound of crashing waves*.
As per 眉# (long, curved eyebrow) + 水 water → long, curved *shore* → *water's edge*; *bank*.
水艸交爲湄。从水眉聲。
㶕也。从水柬聲。
幽溼也。从水音聲。
As per 奏# (gather) + 水 water → ships in a *port/harbor*, gathered/assembled in a tight group → *assemble*.
水上人所會也。从水奏聲。
回也。从水韋聲。
As per 耑# (neatly aligned) + 水 water → *rapids* cascading down a neatly descending watercourse → *rapid currents of a shallows*.
疾瀨也。从水耑聲。
As per 面# (adhere) + 水 water → adhere to/be immersed in liquid → *be immersed in*; *be absorbed in* (an undertaking).
沈於酒也。从水面聲。《周書》曰：“罔敢湎于酒。”
As per 胥# (separate) + 水 water → *strain alcohol*, filtering out the lees/dregs (compare 釃) → *filtered alcohol*.
莤酒也。一曰浚也。一曰露皃。从水胥聲。《詩》曰：“有酒湑我。” 又曰：“零露湑兮。”
雨下也。从水咠聲。一曰沸涌皃。
As per 前# (small increments) + 水 water → *wash* carefully, a little at a time → *cleanse*; *purify*. Compare 洗.
水。出蜀郡緜虒玉壘山，東南入江。从水前聲。一曰手𤃬之。
As per 胡# (rough, covering substance) + 水 water → (originally, a silted) *lake*. Now a lake in the general sense of the word.
大陂也。从水胡聲。揚州浸，有五湖。浸，川澤所仰以灌漑也。
相# mutual + 水 water → name of a river in present-day *Hunan Province*. Legend had it that the river was protected by a pair of goddesses.
水。出零陵陽海山，北入江。从水相聲。
甚# extreme + 水 water → extremely *deep* and *clear* water → *fill*; *be filled with*.
没也。从水甚聲。一曰湛水，豫章浸。
水清底見也。从水是聲。《詩》曰：“湜湜其止。”
水流湝湝也。从水皆聲。一曰湝湝，寒也。《詩》曰：“風雨湝湝。”
水。出南海龍川，西入溱。从水貞聲。
水。出金城臨羌塞外，東入河。从水皇聲。
水。出趙國襄國之西山，東北入寖。从水禺聲。
As per 勇# (run through) + 水 water → water that runs through an aperture in gushing from the earth (compare 涌) → *gush forth/out*; *spring up* (naturally); *breed*.
乳汁也。从水重聲。
As per 秋# (shrunken) + 水 water → *puddle*; *small pond*. In Japan, the character has also been applied to *swampland*.
隘。下也。一曰有湫水，在周地。《春秋傳》曰：“晏子之宅秋隘。”安定朝𨙻有湫泉。从水秋聲。
As per 垔# as described in 煙 (adhere) + 水 water → *sink* and adhere to the bottom of a body of water → *bury*.
没也。从水垔聲。
昜# rise + 水 water → vapor rising from boiling water → *hot water* → (hot) *soup*; *bath*; *hot springs*.
熱水也。从水昜聲。
潺湲，水聲。从水爰聲。
西河美稷𠈃東北水。从水南聲。
As per 甾 (cut) + 水 water → cut pieces of fabric and dye them (*black*; compare 緇) → *dye black*.
原# origin + 水 water → *origin* of a *source* of water → *trace*; *fountain*.
水也。从水𧴪聲。讀若瑣。
薄水也。一曰中絕小水。从水兼聲。

As per 隼# (short, squat bird → weigh heavily) + 水 water → heavy buildup of water (compare 淵) → *level* (← level surface of a heavy buildup of water) → *standard* → *semi-*; *quasi-* (← standard that is unofficially accurate).
平也。从水隼聲。

準.explanation: Use 準 for standard, accurate, or criterion senses; the inherited character 准 also remains in use in certain words such as 批准.
準.example: 标准 → 標準; 批准 → 批准
準.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

entries.text: 盍# (press down and) cover + 水 water → *sudden/abrupt* (cessation) (← suddenly slam a lid on a water container, cutting off the flow of liquid).
奄忽也。从水盍聲。
As per 留# (round) + 水 water → liquid that collects to form a round, slippery puddle (compare 潦) → *collect*; *build up*. Also, *drip* and (rain)*drops* (← drops of rain that collect; compare 霤).
As per 冓# (symmetry) + 水 water → symmetrical constructions that conduct water → *ditch*; *gutter*; *sewer* → *groove*.
水瀆。廣四尺、深四尺。从水冓聲。
冥# darkness + 水 water → *dark, drizzly skies* (compare 暝 and 濛) → *fine rain*; *sea* (← dark waters; compare 海).
小雨溟溟也。从水冥聲。
水。在漢南。从水差聲。荆州浸也。《春秋傳》曰：“脩涂梁溠。”
益/益# fill/full + 水 water → fill to the point of overflowing → *brim* → *spill*; *overflow* → *inundate*. Compare 灎.
器滿也。从水益聲。
As per 尃# as described in 博 (spread) + 水 water → spreading liquid (compare 𠂢 as described in 派) → *spread wide*; *widespread*; *wide*.
大也。从水尃聲。
小雨也。从水，微省聲。
水。出丹陽溧陽縣。从水栗聲。
As per 奚# (aligned) + 水 water → stream/river aligned to the contours of a *valley*. Compare 谿.
水。出犍爲涪，南入黔水。从水𥁕聲。

As per 朔# (conjunction of beginning and end points) + 水 water → *go upstream*/*go against the current* and return to one's starting point. Compare 泝. Also, *retrace the past*; *return to a source/origin*.
水。出桂陽臨武，入匯。从水秦聲。
As per 叟# (narrow aperture) + 水 water → *urine* passing through the narrow ureter. Compare 尿.
水。出南陽蔡陽，東入夏水。从水員聲。
As per 容# (contain voluminous objects) + 水 water → *dissolve/melt* voluminous objects in liquid → *liquefy*; *thaw*; *mix*.
水盛也。从水容聲。
圂# sty + 水 water → *muddy* sty → *dirty* → *disordered*. *Latrine* is a borrowed meaning via 圂.
亂也。一曰水濁皃。从水圂聲。
As per 弱# (supple) + 水 water → immerse in liquid, making an object supple → *be immersed in* → *drown*.
水。自張掖𠛹丹西，至酒泉合黎，餘波入于流沙。从水弱聲。桑欽所說。
幽溼也。从水；一，所以覆也，覆而有土，故溼也。㬎省聲。
As per 辱# (soften) + 水 water → softening moisture → *humid*; *damp*; *muggy*.
溼暑也。从水辱聲。
水名。从水除聲。
As per 旁# (spread to/be on both sides) + 水 water → water flowing in torrents around both sides of an object → *voluminous/torrential flow*.
沛也。从水㫄聲。
As per 翁# (open spaces) + 水 water → water *swelling* then spilling over to open spaces in *dispersing*.
雲气起也。从水翁聲。
倉 here an abbreviated form# of 蒼 green/blue + 水 water → pure (blue) water (compare 清 and 淨) → *blue*; (dark) *green*. Also, *ocean* (← blue water) and *cold* (← pure, cold water).
寒也。从水倉聲。
烕 is 戌 (exterminate) + 火 fire → exterminate a fire. 滅 is 烕# + 水 water → exterminate/*destroy* by water → *annihilate*; *ruin*; *collapse*; *perish*; *die out*.
盡也。从水𤇳聲。
益州池名。从水眞聲。
久雨也。从水高聲。
As per 晃# (extend) + 水 water → long, *wide* stretch of water. Compare 洸 and 汪.
As per 茲# (luxuriant growth) + 水 water → luxuriant growth of water plants → *thrive*; *luxuriant*; *rich*.
益也。从水兹聲。一曰滋水，出牛飲山白陘谷，東入呼沱。
A variant of 浟 (*cleanse*; *wash*; *rinse*), replacing 攸 with 條.
洒也。从水條聲。
水。出南陽魯陽堯山，東北入汝。从水蚩聲。
絕小水也。从水，熒省聲。

As per 骨# (circulate) + 水 water. However, as the character bears the primary meanings*slip*, *slide*, *glide* and *skate*, it is likely that 水 was originally 氷 ice, with the term originally signifying "glide/skate in a circle." Associated and extended meanings include *ski* and *smooth*, along with *fail* and *be demoted* (← slip up and pay the consequences).
利也。从水骨聲。
多汁也。从水哥聲。讀若哥。

As per 宰# (cut) + 水 water → cut the flow of water in damming a stream (compare 才). *Dregs*; *grounds*, *lees*, *leavings*, *dross* and *scum* are associated meanings (← sediment that forms at the bottom of liquid). Compare 糟.
澱也。从水宰聲。
舀# dip + 水 water → dip into liquid, causing an *overflow*.
水漫漫大皃。从水舀聲。
朕# (rise) + a variant of 水 water → *rising water* → *overflow* (← rise to the point of overflowing). Compare 漲.
水超涌也。从水朕聲。
久泔也。从水脩聲。
As per 帶# (tie) + 水 water → tie/bind, constricting the flow of liquid → *stop*; *stay*; *stagnate*; *pile up* → *overdue*. Also, *reside* (← stay).
凝也。从水帶聲。
浚乾漬米也。从水竟聲。《孟子》曰：“夫子去齊，滰淅而行。”
水。起北地靈丘，東入河。从水寇聲。滱水卽漚夷水，并州川也。
As per 參# (commingle) + 水 water → liquid that seeps in or soaks through (compare 漸, 浸 and 潛) → *seep*; *soak*; *permeate*; *infiltrate*.
下漉也。从水參聲。
As per 啇# (variant of 啻) (unify) + 水 water → liquid dripping from a containing unit (compare 液) → *drip*; *drop* → *counter for drips/drops*.
水注也。从水啻聲。
水。出南陽魯陽，入城父。从水敖聲。
鹵# salt/alkali + 水 water → *brine*; *foods soaked in brine* → *cover with salt*. Also, *alkaline soil*.

entries.text: As per 許# (be accepting) + 水 water → riverbank/*shore* (that absorbs the pounding of water) → *vicinity*.
水。出京兆藍田谷，入霸。从水產聲。
As per 袞# (wrap about) + 水 water → bubbles of roiling water rotating (figuratively wrapping about each other) in a pot → *boil*; *seethe* → *tumble*.

㒼# combines the head of an animal and its pelt, suggesting "cover completely" (← cover the body completely with an animal skin that has its head still attached; compare 美). 滿 adds 水 water → inundate (← cover completely with water; compare 漫) → *(be) full*; *fill* → *fulfill*; *all over*.
盈溢也。从水㒼聲。
